charts.title: How a phase ends, by how it started
charts.caption: Corners end in a shot 39.3% of the time and goal kicks 6.2% — a six-fold spread from one restart type to another. Share within each start type, all 16,782 phases.

charts.title: xG of the 2,315 phases that ended in a shot
charts.caption: Log-scaled count, 0.05 bins. Most shooting chances are small ones — 1,050 of the 2,315 sit below 0.05 xG. Gold is the 253 phases that scored.

charts.title: Where a phase starts, and how often it ends in a shot
charts.caption: The 3 × 3 search grid, in the attacking team's frame. Only 199 phases start in the centre of the final third, and 55.3% of them end in a shot — against 8.9% for a phase starting in a team's own defensive centre.

charts.title: Duration against upfield progression
charts.caption: The densest cell is the bottom-left — 760 phases under 2.5 s that gained under 7.5 m. Above it, 45% of all phases gain 30–90 m at almost any duration. Log-scaled counts over all 16,782 phases.
